title: Eka Robotics, which is developing a "vision-force-action" architecture for its physical AI models, raised a $150M Series A at a $1.45B post-money valuation (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim Fernholz / TechCrunch: Eka Robotics, which is developing a “vision-force-action” architecture for its physical AI models, raised a $150M Series A at a $1.45B post-money valuation — Robots still aren't that good at picking things up, despite billions of dollars of investment and endless videos fed into deep learning models.
